cases.sentence: Махиру, первенцу Манассии, предку галаадитян, были выделены Галаад и Башан, потому что махириты были ___.
cases.explain: «храбрыми воинами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

cases.sentence: Свои наделы были выделены и ___ из рода Манассии по их кланам — потомкам Авиезера, Хелека, Асриила, Шехема, Хефера и Шемида.
cases.explain: «остальным людям» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

cases.sentence: Это потомки Манассии, сына Иосифа, ___ по их кланам.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

cases.explain: «остальным потомкам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

cases.sentence: Затем граница Манассии проходила по ___ потока и заканчивалась у моря.
cases.explain: «северной стороне» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

cases.explain: «Южная земля» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

cases.sentence: На землях Иссахара и Асира Манассии принадлежали Бет-Шеан и Ивлеам с ___, жители Дора, Эн-Дора, Таанаха и Мегиддо вместе с окрестными поселениями (третий это Нафеф) .
cases.explain: «окрестными поселениями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.

cases.explain: «окрестными поселениями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.
